title: docs(changeset): correct pending v18 changesets that later train landings made false, in place (deliberate correction)
body:
Fixes #22586
Clause-②: no (pending release text only; no accept set or public surface changes)

## What this does

Edits 21 pending `.changeset/*.md` files in place so that each sentence states what `main` does now. Every one of them is unconsumed (`.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, `tag: next`, 0 consumed changesets, read on `origin/main` `bcebd8409`), so whatever they say when the Version Packages PR #21988 (`18.0.0-next.0`) merges is frozen into every package's CHANGELOG. Today that release would print both the false sentence and the later entry's correction of it.

No new changeset, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no `content/docs/releases/`, no `.changeset/pre.json`, no code. Measured on every edited file against base `c9b5b24b0`: the frontmatter bump block, the `Clause-②` line and the ADR-0087 marker are byte-identical (md5 of the extracted lines), and no control byte is present.

## `check-empty-changeset` is red on purpose: DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` (ruling D on #17712) refuses a diff that modifies a changeset present on the merge base. It names two classes with opposite remedies: COLLISION (restore theirs, rename yours) and DELIBERATE CORRECTION ("do NOT restore it -- say so on the PR and get it confirmed; restoring it from the base would put the false sentence back"). This PR is the second class by design, for all 21 files: each file is a pending note whose sentence a later landing on the same `next` train made false. Nothing here is restored to make the gate green. The gate stays red until the correction is confirmed; the claim on #22586 names that confirmation as an at-tier contract review on the same head.

## Corrections, per file

BEFORE is the base text, AFTER is this PR's text, and the last column is the landing that made BEFORE false (sha, PR).
